status_note: Basic-block-graph adjudication of FLOW-339E-OVERLAP-HLT-0001 (w-rc4 handover: curl main oracle 150 vs Rugra 149 blocks, missing @339e hlt). The seam is NOT a symbol-size truncation and NOT a Rugra flow-code gap: with the callee unmarked (golden_dump_1204 per-function fixture oracle) both sides fall through the 0x3366-style direct call into the _start overlap and produce the hlt self-loop block; with the 'Non-Returning Functions - Known' analyzer attribute set (full-analysis E2E golden) both sides halt at the call. The two cases isolate that data variable on one minimal reproduction of the curl main tail; projections are byte-identical between the locked oracle and Rugra follow_flow_with_callee_protos.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: followFlow mutates the Funcdata in place (obank/bblocks/qlst via the FlowInfo reference; Ghidra: flow.cc:756-783); checkForFlowModification reads the FuncCallSpecs reference and dead-inserts the artificial halt after the CALL op (opDeadInsertAfter, flow.cc:644), and queryCall copies callee flow effects through the FuncProto reference (flow.cc:663-664) — the fixture observes the resulting shared state (blocks, ops, specs, comments), never copies
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: xrefControlFlow walks the dead list forward and, on a noreturn CALL, backs the iterator up one op (--oiter, flow.cc:338-342) to xref the inserted halt so the final RETURN makes isfallthru false; fallthru() pops addrlist LIFO until a non-fallthru instruction; the block projection iterates BlockGraph::getBlock index order (creation order) on both sides
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters; insn_count only feeds the max-instruction guard (not hit); the noreturn/inline bits are a pure bit pair whose lifecycle is queryCall's gated one-way copyFlowEffects overwrite, read once by checkForFlowModification at flow time
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sorts; the comparisons exercised are isNoReturn() (checkForFlowModification flow.cc:641), hasModel()/isInline() (queryCall flow.cc:663 gate), and setFallthruBound's visited-map Address ordering (upper_bound then one step back, flow.cc:495-507), exercised through the two-out-edge cmp/jne block whose duplicate target must dedup to one successor

oracle.signature: void Funcdata::followFlow(const Address &baddr,const Address &eaddr); bool FlowInfo::checkForFlowModification(FuncCallSpecs &fspecs); void FlowInfo::queryCall(FuncCallSpecs &fspecs); PcodeOp *FlowInfo::xrefControlFlow(list<PcodeOp *>::const_iterator oiter,bool &startbasic,bool &isfallthru,FuncCallSpecs *fc); PcodeOp *FlowInfo::firstOp-adjacent BlockGraph surface via FlowBlock::firstOp/getIn/getOut

snapshot_build_link.target: the repository's locked ghidra worktree (satisfies build.rs's sleigh_shim source check)
snapshot_build_link.note: symlink only; the Rust fixture resolves sleigh_specs from the run cwd (repo root)

rugra_source.archive_policy: git archive of the pinned base commit (no src overlays: the seam adjudication found Rugra's flow code already matches the oracle in both data environments); the fixture is compiled directly with rustc against the freshly built librugra.rlib

architecture: x86:LE:64:default (locked fixture binary: gcc -fno-pie naked-function probes; SLEIGH x86-64 via sleigh_specs on both sides)

compiler_spec.note: fixture binary built with g++ -std=c++11 -fno-pie -no-pie; both sides decode the same .text bytes

analysis_options.driver: C++: BfdArchitecture(binary,'default') + init + readLoaderSymbols('::'), the marked callee's FuncProto flag set directly (setNoReturn, the analyzer-side producer), Funcdata::followFlow over the whole code space; Rust: SleighLifter x86-64 + driver-seeded symbol_table + follow_flow_with_callee_protos callee table (clean entry vs no_return entry), eaddr=u64::MAX
analysis_options.access_observer: none: only the public followFlow / BlockGraph surface is observed on both sides
analysis_options.random_seed: none: deterministic flow; blocks/specs iterated in index/insertion order on both sides
analysis_options.error_injection: none: all probes are well-formed x86-64 code
analysis_options.diagnostics: both sides must exit 0 with byte-empty stderr
analysis_options.normalization: address projections reduced to base-relative deltas (Rugra legacy spaceless Address); unique-space varnode offsets projected as the bare space name (allocator-relative SLEIGH temporaries carry no addressable meaning); opcode ids and halt flag nibble values verified bit-identical

cases: ohlt_user_plain: unmarked callee (golden_dump_1204 fixture data environment: BfdArchitecture + readLoaderSymbols, no Java analyzers): flow falls through the direct call into the overlap tail (nopl+endbr64+xor+mov+CALLIND) and lifts the trailing hlt as a self-loop basic block; followFlow (funcdata_op.cc:756-783) bounds are the whole code space and never consult the ELF symbol size; 3 blocks with blk@31 in=[7,31] out=[31]

ohlt_user_marked: callee FuncProto setNoReturn(true) set before flow (the 'Non-Returning Functions - Known' analyzer DB attribute of the full-analysis environment, checked-in ghidra_curl_1204.c): queryCall copyFlowEffects (flow.cc:663-664) + checkForFlowModification (flow.cc:636-651) insert the PcodeOp::noreturn artificial halt dead-inserted after the CALL (flow.cc:641-648); 2 blocks, call block has no out-edge, tail never lifted, 'Subroutine does not return' warning present

ohlt_user_plain.covers: fall-through past an unmarked direct call into a symbol-overlap region; the trailing hlt lifted as a BRANCH-to-self self-loop basic block (the curl-main @339e seam); no symbol-size truncation anywhere in the flow path (bounds are the whole code space); block-graph projection (count, first-op addr deltas, in/out edge deltas) byte-identical

ohlt_user_marked.covers: the analyzer-marked dual: checkForFlowModification's artificialHalt(NORETURN) + opDeadInsertAfter + 'Subroutine does not return' warning (flow.cc:641-648); graph truncated at the call block (no out-edge, no tail ops) exactly like the checked-in full-analysis golden's curl main; callspec noret bit propagation through queryCall's copyFlowEffects gate

out_of_scope_observations.note: The curl main 150-vs-149 block count is a data-environment property, not a flow-code gap: with the 'Non-Returning Functions - Known' analyzer attribute present (E2E full-analysis golden) both sides stop at the 0x3366 __stack_chk_fail call (149 blocks + warning); with it absent (golden_dump_1204 fixture oracle) both sides fall through into the _start overlap and contain the @339e hlt self-loop (150 blocks). RUDRA_ORACLE_FIXTURE_DATA=1 in examples/curl_decompile.rs reproduces the fixture environment for visit-trace comparisons (main verified 150 blocks, blk#147 self-loop, matching oracle BS-OR block-for-block).

With the 150-block parity restored (RUDRA_ORACLE_FIXTURE_DATA=1 + RUDRA_BS_TRACE=1), main's collapse rule-event sequence matches the oracle through event 53; first divergence at #54 (oracle goto@67 vs Rugra if_goto@67), then the missing dowhile@67/@70 absorption chain (oracle events 56/60). Remaining seam is blockaction domain (w-rc4 lease).
